name: Tearful Eyes ~Anata Shika Inai~
original_name: ティアフルアイズ～あなたしかいない～
source:
Main character meet a girl on the hill behind the school. She lies on the hill wearing a white dress instead of uniform. He only dares to talk to her after becoming festival committee member, and they seem to have much in common, but she asks to keep white dress in secret. However, after becoming friends, protagonist starts to notice strange shadows behind the girl personality. One day she stops talking to him...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在学校后山的山丘上遇见了一名少女。她身穿白色连衣裙躺在山坡上，而不是穿着校服。直到成为学园祭执行委员后，他才鼓起勇气与她交谈，两人似乎有许多共同点，但她要求他对那身白裙保密。然而，两人成为朋友后，主人公开始察觉她的性格背后隐藏着诡异的阴影。某天，她不再与他说话了……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
